data.summary: Repair Commerce PR #9 by preserving valid identity-bearing stock states, returning identity-less or malformed managed persisted states as setup-required, and rejecting malformed needs-review confirmation input. Verify legacy replay, valid replay, malformed confirmation, full repository contracts, runtime behavior, and exact-head independent review. No live Inventory mutation, deployment, or merge is included.

alternatives: Use a new commandId for each retry, accepting that an ambiguous timeout may return existing and require unnecessary user confirmation.
data.reason: A stable hidden retry identity preserves idempotency across network uncertainty without changing the customer-visible SKU or Inventory SKU identity.
data.recommended: Make Commerce registration retries reuse one durable operation ID as the Inventory commandId so a timed-out successful registration remains the same request.
